const NetBirdAgentUnit = "terrascale-netbird-agent.service"

// NetBirdAgentService is deploy/systemd's copy byte for byte. The worker
// applies signed host commands under root without broadening host privileges.
const NetBirdAgentService = `[Unit]
Description=Apply authenticated TerraScale NetBird client changes
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target terrascale-orchestrator-host-setup.service
PartOf=terrascale-orchestrator-host.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/terrascale-orchestrator/host.json
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecCondition=/bin/sh -c 'b=/var/lib/terrascale-orchestrator/current/terrascale-orchestrator; [ -x "$$b" ] || b=/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator; exec "$$b" netbird agent run --help'
ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'b=/var/lib/terrascale-orchestrator/current/terrascale-orchestrator; [ -x "$$b" ] || b=/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator; exec "$$b" netbird agent run --config /etc/terrascale-orchestrator/host.json'
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
UMask=0077
StateDirectory=terrascale-netbird-agent terrascale-orchestrator/netbird-managed
StateDirectoryMode=0700
# This root worker verifies signed host commands before changing the binary
# or systemd units; the workload host remains under ProtectSystem=strict.
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
LockPersonality=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
SystemCallArchitectures=native

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
`

const NetBirdAgentHostDropin = "[Unit]\nWants=terrascale-netbird-agent.service\nAfter=terrascale-netbird-agent.service\n\n[Service]\nInaccessiblePaths=-/var/lib/terrascale-netbird-agent -/var/lib/terrascale-orchestrator/netbird-managed\n"

const NetBirdEnrollDropin = `[Service]
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'b=/var/lib/terrascale-orchestrator/current/terrascale-orchestrator; [ -x "$$b" ] || b=/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator; exec "$$b" netbird-enroll --config /etc/terrascale-orchestrator/netbird.json'
# A missing client is installed from the verified image fallback.
ReadWritePaths=/usr/local/bin /var/lib/terrascale-orchestrator
`

// InstallNetBirdAgent adds the privileged worker only to managed hosts.
func InstallNetBirdAgent(systemdDir string) (bool, error) {
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(systemdDir, HostSetupUnit)); errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return false, nil
	} else if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	changed := false
	for relative, contents := range map[string]string{
		NetBirdAgentUnit: NetBirdAgentService,
		"terrascale-orchestrator-host.service.d/65-netbird-agent.conf": NetBirdAgentHostDropin,
		"terrascale-netbird-enroll.service.d/zz-selfupdate.conf":       NetBirdEnrollDropin,
	} {
		path := filepath.Join(systemdDir, relative)
		if current, err := os.ReadFile(path); err == nil && string(current) == contents {
			continue
		}
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
			return changed, err
		}
		if err := writeFileAtomic(path, []byte(contents), 0o644); err != nil {
			return changed, err
		}
		changed = true
	}
	return changed, nil
}

[Unit]
Description=TerraScale Orchestrator host runtime
Wants=network-online.target
Requires=terrascale-orchestrator-host-setup.service
After=network-online.target terrascale-orchestrator-host-setup.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/terrascale-orchestrator/host.json
# Availability first: the restart backoff below reaches its 5min cap after
# seven starts (about 10 minutes), so at most about 17 starts fit in any hour
# and a loop at the capped backoff never reaches this burst; the host keeps
# retrying through a controller outage of any length. The limit only fails a
# runtime that restarts faster than that backoff (for example after a manual
# reset-failed), and the host-setup timer starts a failed runtime again.
StartLimitIntervalSec=1h
StartLimitBurst=20

[Service]
# READY=1 once the host is connected to its regional cell. No WatchdogSec=:
# restarting this process stops every supervised TerraBase member.
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=main
TimeoutStartSec=3min
# Runs as root by default: User=root with NoNewPrivileges=yes would make
# systemd drop CAP_SETUID, which the native workload helper needs.
SupplementaryGroups=
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator host --config /etc/terrascale-orchestrator/host.json
# Protect the host manager without throttling the managed database when idle.
# MemoryMin/MemoryLow come from the image profile; the native runner copies

CPUSchedulingPolicy=other

# image with terrascale-orchestrator-selfupdate-watchdog@controller.timer.

[Unit]
Description=TerraScale self-update watchdog for terrascale-orchestrator-%i.service
# The image enables the controller and host instances; see
# docs/continuous-delivery.md. Where the role's config is absent no process
# can prove an activation of its unit, and deadlines still roll back.

[Service]
Type=oneshot
# Confirms a pending activation from the unit's fresh signed version proof,
# or rolls the current link back after the deadline and restarts the unit.
# This also covers a new release that hangs instead of crashing. The role
# config names the unit's key and, optionally, its proof file. The baked
# binary hands the check to the node's known-good release, so these
# arguments must stay valid for every release.
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator selfupdate watchdog --root /var/lib/terrascale-orchestrator --unit terrascale-orchestrator-%i.service --config /etc/terrascale-orchestrator/%i.json
# A hung check would stop the timer, which only fires after a run ends.
TimeoutStartSec=60s
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
